answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1982 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the dune. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the zenith queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 430 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
